title: Star-exponential for Fermi systems and the Feynman-Kac formula
summary: Inspired by the formalism that relates the star-exponential with the quantum propagator for bosonic systems, in this work we introduce the analogous extension for the fermionic case. In particular, we analyse the problem of calculating the star-exponential (i.e., the symbol of the evolution operator) for Fermi systems within the deformation quantization program. Grassmann variables and coherent states are considered in order to obtain a closed-form expression for the fermionic star-exponential in terms of its associated propagator.
